output.reason: The proposed exposure is far too broad. Nearly every Argo CD install uses AppProject, and a 'cmpServer' text match in a ConfigMap does not show that a plugin is given an empty env var. [ev-2e6e2425e73c] and [ev-485285677821] say the change only affects sidecar config management plugins called with an ARGOCD_ENV_ variable set to an empty string: before, the variable was dropped; now it is passed. But no excerpt names the manifest field that carries plugin env vars, or which resource kinds hold it, so a correct resource/field predicate can't be written from the evidence. The upgrade-guide text changed in the PR (docs/operator-manual/upgrading/2.14-3.0.md, [ev-10e2e70d7018]) is not shown and would likely settle this.
